instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to burst in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: A balloon bursts when too much air is inflated.
atoms.b: A balloon ((bursts)) when too much air is inflated.

atoms.sound: The student burst into the room, interrupting the lesson.
atoms.b: The student ((burst)) into the room, interrupting the lesson.

atoms.b: The children had ((burst)) out of the classroom as soon as the bell rang.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to knit in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to knit</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

hint.text: Das Verb to knit kann sowohl im simple past als auch im past participle in zwei Formen verwendet werden: knit und knitted.
hint.label: Tipp

atoms.sound: She knits sweatshirts from soft wool.
She also knit/knitted a blanket to donate to the shelter.
atoms.b: She also ((knit/knitted)) a blanket to donate to the shelter.

atoms.sound: She has knit/knitted a new hat for her baby too.
atoms.b: She has ((knit/knitted)) a new hat for her baby too.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to flee in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to flee</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: The rabbit flees from the wildfire.
A photographer saw the rabbit which suddenly fled when it sensed his presence.
atoms.b: A photographer saw the rabbit which suddenly ((fled)) when it sensed his presence.

atoms.sound: Therefore, the rabbit had fled as soon as it could.
atoms.b: Therefore, the rabbit had ((fled)) as soon as it could.
